<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The meeting has been booked by Alison for Thursday at 14:30. My task is now to send the confirmation email to all four partners. I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function for this. I need to specify the day, start time, and the body of the email. After sending the email, the task will be complete.

*   Day: Thursday
*   Start time: 14:30
*   Body: I will write a professional email confirming the meeting details.

This will be my first and only action needed for this session. After this, I'll end the session.I have confirmation that the meeting has been booked. My final task is to send the confirmation email to the partners.
